explanation: For λ>0, the Neumann conditions give y=B cos(5x√λ) and 5√λ=n, so λ_n=n²/25. Also, λ=0 is an eigenvalue with nonzero constant eigenfunctions. Thus the selected formulas describe the complete answer if n=0,1,2,…; if N means only positive integers, the displayed choices omit the zero eigenvalue. This indexing convention is unresolved.
